fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects the execution of the "msxsl" binary with an "http" keyword in the command line. This might indicate a potential remote execution of XSL files.
fields.name: Remote XSL Execution Via Msxsl.EXE
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="windows" and (tgt.process.image.path contains "\\msxsl.exe" and tgt.process.cmdline contains "http"))
